prompt: Convert RIKEN lipidomics TSV pair, supplying study-level metadata (mzTab-ID, title, contact, instrument, software, ms_run location, scan polarity).

assertions.name: output_file_exists
assertions.description: Output file /tmp/eval_runs/eval-1/output/study.mztab exists and is non-empty

assertions.name: in_memory_validation_zero_errors
assertions.description: Re-reading with auto_complete_ids=True yields zero ERROR messages

assertions.name: instrument_q_exactive
assertions.description: MTD instrument[1]-name references Q Exactive HF (cv accession MS:1002416)

assertions.name: software_msdial_490
assertions.description: MTD software[1] line includes 'MS-DIAL' and version '4.90'

assertions.name: ms_run_location_template
assertions.description: MTD ms_run[1]-location starts with 'file:///riken/' and ends with '.mzML'
